svg.text: joined to the cranium by a 1m fillet
lenses from circles r 6.4m, 2m wide, based ±1.6m,
holes r 1.2m at ±1.55m, chile discs r 0.85m inside
two only: a marigold on the brow (six petals
r 0.42m on a 0.55m ring), and a stitched smile
Bone #fff4e2 · chile #d1255c · marigold #faae33 on brown. Nothing freehand, no filler dots.
